import numpy as np
Ng, L = 8, 5.0
x = np.arange(Ng)*L/Ng
kn = np.where(np.arange(Ng) < Ng//2, np.arange(Ng), np.arange(Ng)-Ng)
Gv = 2*np.pi*kn/L
jj = np.arange(Ng)
Fm = np.exp(-2j*np.pi*np.outer(jj, jj)/Ng)/np.sqrt(Ng)
V = 0.8*np.cos(2*np.pi*x/L) + 0.3*np.sin(4*np.pi*x/L)
H = Fm.conj().T @ np.diag((0.5*Gv**2).astype(complex)) @ Fm + np.diag(V.astype(complex))
H = (H + H.conj().T)/2
mu, beta, nocc = 1.2, 8.0, 5
w, U = np.linalg.eigh(H)
Phi = U[:, :nocc]; wo = w[:nocc]
fo = 1.0/(1.0 + np.exp(np.clip(beta*(wo - mu), -700.0, 700.0)))
dV = 0.4*np.cos(2*np.pi*x/L) - 0.2*np.sin(4*np.pi*x/L) + 0.05
assert np.allclose(sternheimer_solve(H, Phi, wo, 0, dV, 1e-12, 300), target)
